report.speaker: Valentino Tosatti
report.title: Ricci-Flat Metrics on Calabi–Yau Manifolds
report.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
report.question: 固定紧 Kähler 流形的复结构，当 Ricci 平坦度量的 Kähler 类趋于锥边界时，体积、正流、局部光滑几何和 Gromov–Hausdorff 极限分别由什么决定，纤维化与逼近路径又如何影响它们？
report.reading_scope: Read the entire mathematical body, sections 1–4 and bibliography, of arXiv:2509.25607v2, 24 PDF pages, in consecutive pdftotext ranges; compared all mathematical sections and numbered statements against the official SIAM full HTML. Supplemental original papers were read selectively as itemized below, not in full. The SIAM CC BY 4.0 notice was checked on the official page and independently confirmed by the coordinating agent.

proof_scope.2R01: Ricci-form volume-ratio identity and constancy of a pluriharmonic function on a connected compact Kahler manifold proved using Stokes. Chern-Weil identification is external. Uses rho=-(1/2)dd^c log det g with dd^c=i/pi partial barpartial, hence rho=Ric_standard/(2pi).
proof_scope.2R02: Deduction of the Ricci-flat representative theorem from the dd^c lemma and Yau's general prescribed-positive-volume theorem 2N04; uniqueness uses 2N03. Existence estimates and dd^c lemma are external. Calabi–Yau means compact Kahler with c1(X)=0 in real cohomology, without projectivity, simple connectedness or holomorphically trivial canonical bundle assumptions.
proof_scope.2R03: Constant metric scaling and biholomorphic pullback identities proved directly, including length and volume scaling.
proof_scope.2R04: Openness, convexity and nef approximation established using finite-dimensional representatives, positivity and the dd^c lemma. Analytic nef real classes are distinguished from the existing projective nef line-bundle definition.
proof_scope.2R05: Volume is the top-intersection polynomial, so the collapse/noncollapse dichotomy is proved by continuity. The nef positive-top-intersection iff big theorem is an external Demailly–Paun input.
proof_scope.2R06: Null locus is defined for nef classes. Equality with the non-Kahler locus and a strictly positive current smooth off the null locus are cited only under nef and big hypotheses, correcting the report's omitted big assumption.
proof_scope.2R07: General real nef and big noncollapsing boundary theorem quoted with weak-current, minimal-singularity and local smooth convergence conclusions. Global singular Monge–Ampere existence and estimates are not reproved.
proof_scope.2R08: Sixteen fixed points, exceptional-curve area and preservation of positive top intersection calculated. Kummer resolution geometry and analytic convergence are external inputs.
proof_scope.2R09: Boundedness inheritance from minimal singularities proved by two inequalities and compact upper boundedness. The same comparison definition is used in general pseudoeffective classes; existing 2N07 states its construction in big classes.
proof_scope.2R0A: Transcendental contraction conjecture stated; known dimension and projectivity cases reported with source, not proved.
proof_scope.2R0B: Global potential regularity questions distinguished from smooth convergence off the null locus; known semiample special cases cited.
proof_scope.2R0C: Path-dependent weak-current example quoted from report Theorem 3.1 with construction mechanism. This is not an independently reconstructed dynamical proof.
proof_scope.2R0D: Straight-path Monge–Ampere normalization constant derived by total mass, retaining arbitrary smooth representative alpha and choosing the auxiliary class's Ricci-flat representative.
proof_scope.2R0E: Semiample real class defined by pullback from a normal compact Kahler space; smooth regular base and discriminant separated. Rational/line-bundle semiampleness is not presumed.
proof_scope.2R0F: Restricted tangent exact sequence and Whitney formula prove real c1=0 for smooth fibres. General Ehresmann local differentiable triviality is an external theorem; 1907 supplies only a circle-base special case.
proof_scope.2R0G: Full binomial calculation gives the positive t^(n-m) leading coefficient; vanishing of higher base powers and the zero-dimensional-base case are explicit.
proof_scope.2R0H: Pushforward Monge–Ampere equation specified with normalized total mass and a possibly singular base. Existence, uniqueness and regularity of the canonical base potential are cited analytic results.
proof_scope.2R0I: Global potential bound and local quasi-isometry on compact subsets away from singular fibres quoted from report section 3.3.2, equations (3.4) and (3.5). Constants need not remain uniform at the discriminant.
proof_scope.2R0J: Intrinsic fibre diameter two-sided sqrt(t) estimate derived from metric comparison and compact smooth trivialization; ambient fibre diameter receives only an upper bound.
proof_scope.2R0K: Explicit product metric (1+t)g_B+t g_F, exact product distances, fibre scale and volume computed; GH convergence follows from the independently proved correspondence estimate.
proof_scope.2R0L: Fibrewise Yau solutions normalized and assembled into the semi-Ricci-flat form. Parametric elliptic regularity and dd^c gluing are external inputs; total-space semipositivity is not asserted.
proof_scope.2R0M: Hein–Tosatti smooth collapse theorem quoted in every dimension on compact subsets of the regular locus, for the entire straight-path family. Fixed-background C^k topology is explicit; no general numerical convergence rate is asserted.
proof_scope.2R0N: Quadratic semi-flat potential, exact t-lambda rescaling identity and one-dimensional constant-period example computed. Descent under lattice translations is cited rather than independently calculated; general existence of torus semi-flat geometry is external context.
proof_scope.2R0O: Superpolynomial error after subtracting the base-averaged term quoted in torus or locally holomorphically product cases. The rate of the base average itself remains unspecified.
proof_scope.2R0P: Proof outline only: three rescaling regimes and their limiting spaces. Liouville theorems, collapsing Schauder estimates and the iterative selection argument remain external to these notes.
proof_scope.2R0Q: Fixed versus collapsing tensor and Holder norm scaling calculated on a product. Levi-Civita product connection is reused; no general degeneration estimate is inferred from the model alone.
proof_scope.2R0R: Original Hein–Tosatti Theorem B first correction quoted with its negative sign, harmonic Kodaira–Spencer representatives, zero-mean inverse fibre Laplacians and normalization conversion. Harmonic theory, inverse existence and all remainder estimates are external. The full remainder is not claimed to be o(t^2).
proof_scope.2R0S: Finite-order asymptotic theorem and conjectural order-compatible full expansion separated. Integer-power rates are described as an open problem.
proof_scope.2R0T: Rough nonsemiample K3 limit theorem cited. Eigenclass zero-square calculation is elementary; automorphism construction, rigidity and nowhere-continuous behavior remain external.
proof_scope.2R0U: Conditional deduction of whole-family weak convergence from positive-current subsequence compactness and uniqueness of the current. Compactness, positivity under weak limits and dynamical rigidity are external inputs.
proof_scope.2R0V: Bounded-potential conjecture and reported special cases stated, without identifying bounded potentials with continuous two-form coefficients.
proof_scope.2R0W: Minimal-singularity conjecture for arbitrary paths distinguished from the straight-path subsequential result. Existence of cluster limits with minimal singularities does not itself give uniqueness.
proof_scope.2R0X: Irrational zero-square K3 rigidity conjecture and relevant rationality convention stated; known dynamical cases cited.
proof_scope.2R0Y: GH definition and complete proof of correspondence equivalence. Both directions are supplied, including the cross-space metric, positivity, all mixed triangle inequalities and Hausdorff bound. Isometry-class metric theory beyond this equivalence is not reconstructed.
proof_scope.2R0Z: Exact GH distance to a point equals half the diameter; scaling consequence proved from correspondence distortion.
proof_scope.2R10: Uniform diameter bound and Ricci-nonnegative GH precompactness cited. Conclusion is subsequential compactness, not uniqueness of the limit or a positive diameter lower bound.
proof_scope.2R11: Noncollapse GH completion theorem cited. The general real-class conclusion is separated from homeomorphism and real-codimension-four claims requiring additional semiample/integral hypotheses.
proof_scope.2R12: Report Theorem 4.6 quoted for collapse completion and topology. Original Szekelyhidi theorem is identified as projective with semiample line bundle and ample perturbation, whereas the report states the broader Kahler formulation. Singular base, discriminant and its Hausdorff-dimension bound are explicit.
proof_scope.2R13: Straight-path flat-torus quotient formula proved by the infimum over the lattice, monotone convergence and uniform equicontinuity. Closed-subgroup/torus quotient structure is an external elementary Lie-group input. No arbitrary-path extension is claimed.
proof_scope.2R14: Irrational K3 diameter-collapse conjecture stated for fixed complex structure and unnormalized metrics; it is not a diameter-one degeneration statement.
proof_scope.2R15: Rational nef semiampleness conjecture stated at the class level. Flat twists distinguish a semiample class from an arbitrary line-bundle representative.
proof_scope.2R16: Kahler–Ricci-flow application cited. Initial metric is on the total space X, and the unnormalized standard Ricci form is explicitly distinguished from 2R01's normalized form.
proof_scope.2R17: Smooth-fibration rigidity theorem cited; finite-cover global product conclusion retains projectivity, while local holomorphic triviality applies more generally.
proof_scope.2R18: Independent explicit E^2 integer-automorphism counterexample fully calculated: F_k determinant one, tensor limit nonzero, metric isometry to k^(-2) times the fixed flat metric, diameter tending to zero, and comparison with a straight path retaining E.

remaining_branches: Yau existence, dd^c lemma, Chern-Weil/Whitney identities and general Ehresmann theorem remain external foundations.
Demailly–Paun, Collins–Tosatti null-locus theory, singular Monge–Ampere existence and noncollapse regularity are cited deep inputs.
Uniform collapsing estimates, Liouville and Schauder theorems, harmonic Kodaira–Spencer theory and the full Hein–Tosatti multiscale expansion are not reproved.
Dynamical K3 construction and rigidity, diameter estimates, GH precompactness, metric-completion topology and singular-set dimension theorems remain cited research results.
The report's open problems remain conjectures or questions; no missing proof is silently completed by an analogy or model.

source_errata: Report Theorem 2.2 omits bigness from the claim of a current bounded below by epsilon omega. A nef class of zero top intersection cannot have such a current. 2R06 retains nef and big, following Collins–Tosatti Theorem 1.1; the null-locus definition itself still allows nonbig nef classes.

Report equation (3.13) prints a positive sign in the first Kodaira–Spencer correction. Original Hein–Tosatti Theorem B equation (1.6), visually checked in the PDF, has a negative sign. 2R0R follows the original and converts i partial barpartial to pi dd^c.

Report Example 4.4's kernel-leaf-closure description does not hold for arbitrary converging flat-metric paths. 2R18 gives a fully explicit counterexample on E^2; 2R13 proves the correct straight-path statement.
Report section 3.3.7 places the initial KRF metric on Y; the flow is on X. 2R16 states the initial metric on X.
In the elliptic K3 discussion, pushforward of the volume form is pi_*(omega^2), rather than the square of pi_*omega. The new base equation uses the correct top-degree pushforward.

Occasional pi/f map-name changes in section 3.3 are normalized to f locally. The original asymptotic small parameter is the exponential of minus the original time variable; writing that time variable as s, these notes use t=e^(-s).

calculable_models.calculation: Sixteen involution fixed points on a complex two-torus; exceptional-curve areas vanish while total volume stays positive.
Binomial leading term C(n,m)t^(n-m) integral f^*eta^m wedge omega^(n-m).
Exact product distances and volumes for (1+t)g_B+t g_F, with an explicit GH error bound.
Quadratic semi-flat potential, dilation identity and one-dimensional period Z=i.
t^2 Hessian correction and collapsing k-th derivative norm t^(1-k/2).
Straight-path flat-torus quotient determined by the closed subgroup generated by kernel leaves.
Integer matrix [[k,1],[-1,0]], determinant one; k^(-2) pullback tends to a nonzero rank-one form but the GH limit is a point.

not_substituted.2N04: General prescribed-volume Yau theorem, not a definition of c1=0 or Calabi–Yau; 2R02 states the convention locally and derives the Ricci-flat result.
not_substituted.2N01: dd^c=i/pi partial barpartial retained throughout. 0BFG standard Ricci differs by 2pi from 2R01's normalized Ricci form.
not_substituted.2N07: Existing minimal-singularity construction is stated for big classes; 2R09 explicitly gives the same comparison condition in the general pseudoeffective setting.
not_substituted.0BHB: Projective nef line bundles via curves do not define the general analytic nef real (1,1) class. 2R04 proves its approximation characterization.
not_substituted.2307: Semiample line bundles reused but not substituted for real pullback classes on possibly nonprojective spaces.
not_substituted.1907: Circle-base submersion result illustrates Ehresmann but does not prove the general-base theorem.
not_substituted.2600: Existing uniformization outline inspected for context, not used as an atomic prerequisite.
not_substituted.0F51: Smooth real cotangent bundle is reused as background; the holomorphic cotangent bundle is its complexified (1,0) subbundle, explicitly distinguished in 2R02.
not_substituted.0AL7: Rank-one locally free sheaves are reused only in the projective K3 special case of 2R0V.
